title: Semantic and SVD variants added cost without established serving value
summary: The measured semantic variants were slower than wait-hint ARC. Lossy SVD changed outputs: rank 4 failed 36 of 72 authored QA checks, while rank 8 passing the narrow fixture did not establish general equivalence.
scope: Fifty-four serving cases, 972 responses on RTX 2080 Ti and Qwen2.5-1.5B.
limitations: Scripted public waits provided no advance prefetch window. The study measures cost and narrow quality effects; it cannot reject every semantic or prefetch opportunity.
decision: Keep exact KV as the current behavior and retain the failed/inconclusive alternatives as evidence, without importing their implementation.
